details: Added localStorage tracking for read updates. Clicking an update marks it as read, removes the badge, and dims the card slightly.
อัปเดตสถานะและ Work Instruction ของ Agent Workflow
Transformed the /explore page into an e-commerce style homepage with Search, Hero Banner, Industry Categories, Hot Missions, and Featured Projects carousels.
Transformed the /project/[id] page into a dashboard summarizing the Big Picture (Budget/Rev-Share), missing roles, and the connected team, focusing on the Make A Dot concept.
Created /profile/settings/feature-studio/page.tsx, a UI to help the admin structure feature requests into AI Prompts.
Created /project/[id]/simulator/page.tsx UI and /api/projects/[id]/simulate backend API to run scenario analysis (Best/Expected/Worst cases). Updated Project details page to link to the simulator.
Created /profile/settings/dot-synthesizer and /api/ai/synthesize to allow admins to brainstorm and merge scattered ideas into structured smart choices, aware of project history and schema.
Added auto-fallback model logic to /api/ai/synthesize/route.ts to prevent AI_APICallError during high demand by automatically failing over to fallback models defined in SystemConfig.
Injected gemini-1.5-flash and gemini-1.5-pro to the fallback list directly in /api/ai/synthesize/route.ts because some newer experimental models do not support the generateObject (Interactions) API.
Updated Prisma SystemConfig GLOBAL to use gemini-1.5-pro and gemini-1.5-flash as the actual DB values so the Admin UI correctly reflects the safe models.
Restored the dynamic Tech Updates (Inbox) UI back into AgentHubClient.tsx because it was accidentally removed by another agent.
Implemented line clamping for long summaries, added an expand/collapse toggle, handled unread badge clearing on click, and added an Important badge for highly relevant updates.
